fusions.name: Plodding Tread
fusions.desc: A plodding stamp that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Gore
fusions.desc: Gores a target, which deals 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Grazing Ground
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of pasture where you stand, reaching 3.5 tiles. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Draught Strength
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 10% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your mana recovers 15% faster.
